source_provenance: Academic benchmark published in Computers & Security / IEEE (Prasad et al.)
intended_model_pipeline: Lexical and host feature extractor + Gradient Boosting / Random Forest classifier
offline_policy: Live crawling is strictly disabled by default; URL analysis operates exclusively on lexical, structural, and host features to eliminate SSRF and exploit hazards.
known_limitations: Phishing campaigns evolve rapidly; newly registered domains (NRDs) and zero-day redirection techniques require periodic threshold re-calibration.
A benign score does not guarantee safety; the system treats clean URLs as 'benign_likely', never 'guaranteed safe'.
